<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Rutgers Microfilm × BTAA — Collection Intelligence</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#f4f6fb;--panel:#fff;--ink:#172033;--muted:#687086;--line:#dde2ec;--soft:#edf1f8;--red:#c03;--gold:#f2b544;--green:#18794e;--shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(30,41,59,.09)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:14px/1.45 Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}
button,input,select{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}.shell{max-width:1500px;margin:auto;padding:0 28px 60px}
.hero{background:radial-gradient(circle at 88% 20%,rgba(255,255,255,.16),transparent 28%),linear-gradient(128deg,#670d26,#c03 52%,#e4582d);color:#fff;padding:32px max(28px,calc((100vw - 1444px)/2));overflow:hidden}
.hero-org{text-align:center;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.78;margin-bottom:14px}.hero-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px}.eyebrow{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.78}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(30px,5vw,58px);line-height:1.02;margin:9px 0 12px;max-width:900px}.hero p{font-size:16px;max-width:780px;margin:0;opacity:.9}
.hero-mark{width:112px;height:112px;border-radius:28px;background:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(58,0,16,.3);flex:none}.hero-mark img{width:86px;height:86px;object-fit:contain}
.logo-ribbon{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(18,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:27px}.logo-ribbon img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:contain;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:7px}
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin:-24px 0 24px;position:relative}.kpi{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:17px 19px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.kpi b{display:block;font-size:30px;line-height:1.1}.kpi span{color:var(--muted)}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:20px 0}.tab{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);padding:10px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700}.tab.active{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-color:var(--ink)}
.toolbar{position:sticky;top:8px;z-index:20;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 230px 200px auto;gap:10px;background:rgba(244,246,251,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);padding:12px 0}
.control{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);padding:11px 13px;color:var(--ink)}.reset{border:0;border-radius:12px;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:0 18px;font-weight:700}
.section-head{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;margin:25px 0 12px}.section-head h2{font-size:22px;margin:0}.section-head p{color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.university-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:12px}.uni{position:relative;text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);border-radius:18px;padding:15px;min-height:180px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(30,41,59,.04);transition:.18s transform,.18s box-shadow}.uni:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.uni.selected{outline:3px solid var(--school);outline-offset:1px}.uni-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.uni-logo{width:58px;height:58px;object-fit:contain}.uni-count{font-size:27px;font-weight:800}.uni h3{font-size:15px;margin:12px 0 6px}.uni-meter{height:7px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--soft);overflow:hidden;margin:11px 0}.uni-meter i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--school);border-radius:inherit}.meta{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.status-dot{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:5px}.possible{background:var(--gold)}.unchecked{background:#9aa3b5}.source{background:var(--red)}
.focus{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(360px,.9fr);gap:16px;margin-top:18px}.panel{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(30,41,59,.04)}
.focus-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}.focus-title img{width:64px;height:64px;object-fit:contain}.focus-title h2{margin:0;font-size:22px}.focus-title p{margin:3px 0 0;color:var(--muted)}
.bars{margin-top:20px}.bar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr 50px;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:11px 0}.track{height:11px;background:var(--soft);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}.track i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:inherit}.bar strong{text-align:right}
.callout{border-left:4px solid var(--gold);background:#fff8e6;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:0 12px 12px 0;color:#634a10;margin-top:16px}
.rank-list{display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}.rank{display:grid;grid-template-columns:32px 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:9px 2px}.rank:last-child{border:0}.rank-num{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--soft);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800}.rank button{border:0;background:transparent;text-align:left;color:var(--ink);padding:0}.rank small{color:var(--muted)}
.table-wrap{overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:var(--panel)}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:880px}th,td{padding:12px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid #edf0f5;text-align:left;vertical-align:top}th{position:sticky;top:0;background:#f8f9fc;z-index:2;font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--muted)}tr:hover td{background:#fbfcfe}.title-btn{border:0;background:transparent;padding:0;text-align:left;color:var(--ink);font-weight:750}.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 8px;background:#fff0c7;color:#6b4f00;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.badge.gray{background:var(--soft);color:var(--muted)}.count-bubbles{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px}.bubble{width:27px;height:27px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--soft);display:grid;place-items:center}.bubble img{width:21px;height:21px;object-fit:contain}.evidence-link{color:#9c1739;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none}.evidence-link:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.empty{padding:46px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)}.footnote{color:var(--muted);margin:18px 2px}
dialog{width:min(920px,calc(100% - 30px));max-height:88vh;border:0;border-radius:22px;padding:0;box-shadow:0 40px 100px rgba(12,20,38,.35)}dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(12,20,38,.58);backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}.modal-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.modal-head h2{margin:0}.close{border:0;background:var(--soft);border-radius:10px;width:38px;height:38px;font-size:21px}.modal-body{padding:20px;overflow:auto}.record{display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px 0}.record img{width:46px;height:46px;object-fit:contain}.record:last-child{border:0}
.gr-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:4px 0 20px}.gr-hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#172033,#313e59);color:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:24px;margin:5px 0 18px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:22px;align-items:center}.gr-hero h2{font-size:28px;margin:3px 0 8px}.gr-hero p{margin:0;max-width:780px;color:#dce3f2}.gr-stamp{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-radius:16px;padding:13px 16px;text-align:center;min-width:170px}.gr-stamp b{font-size:24px;display:block}.gr-toolbar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 240px 210px auto;gap:10px;margin:0 0 18px}.gr-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:11px}.gr-uni{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);border-radius:17px;padding:14px;text-align:left;min-height:155px;transition:.18s transform,.18s box-shadow}.gr-uni:hover,.gr-uni.selected{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.gr-uni.selected{outline:3px solid var(--school);outline-offset:1px}.logo-fallback{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--school);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:900;font-size:20px}.gr-match{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}.method{font-size:11px;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 7px;background:#eaf0ff;color:#314c85;font-weight:750}.method.strong{background:#e5f5ec;color:#17633f}.gr-count{font-size:30px;font-weight:850}.gr-note{background:#eef3fb;border:1px solid #d8e1f0;border-radius:15px;padding:13px 15px;color:#41516c;margin:18px 0}.gr-table table{min-width:1020px}.gr-table td:first-child{max-width:400px}
.glossary-intro{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#f1f4fa);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:24px;margin:5px 0 22px}.glossary-intro h2{font-size:28px;margin:3px 0 8px}.glossary-intro p{color:var(--muted);max-width:900px;margin:0}.glossary-group{margin:24px 0}.glossary-group h3{font-size:17px;margin:0 0 11px}.glossary-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:12px}.term-card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:17px;padding:17px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(30,41,59,.04)}.term-card h4{font-size:16px;margin:0 0 7px}.term-card p{color:#4f5a70;margin:0}.term-card .term-caution{display:block;color:#8a2743;font-size:12px;font-weight:750;margin-top:9px}.glossary-rule{border-left:4px solid var(--red);background:#fff0f3;border-radius:0 14px 14px 0;padding:14px 16px;margin-top:22px;color:#6f1b34}
.rutgers-only-hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#670d26,#9d163c);color:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:24px;margin:5px 0 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:22px}.rutgers-only-hero h2{font-size:28px;margin:3px 0 8px}.rutgers-only-hero p{max-width:850px;margin:0;color:#f8dce5}.review-meter{min-width:190px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;text-align:center}.review-meter b{display:block;font-size:26px}.candidate-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 9px;background:#f9e1e8;color:#8a1738;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}.review-complete{font-weight:800;color:var(--green)}.review-incomplete{font-weight:800;color:#8a5c00}
.decision-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;min-width:230px}.decision-btn{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:#fff;padding:7px 9px;color:var(--ink);font-size:11px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.2;text-align:left}.decision-btn:hover{box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(30,41,59,.12)}.decision-btn.keep{border-color:#9bc8ae;color:#17633f}.decision-btn.remove{border-color:#e3a7b7;color:#8a1738}.decision-btn.keep.selected{background:#17633f;border-color:#17633f;color:#fff}.decision-btn.remove.selected{background:#8a1738;border-color:#8a1738;color:#fff}.decision-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 9px;background:var(--soft);color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-weight:800}.decision-badge.kept{background:#e5f5ec;color:#17633f}.decision-badge.removed{background:#f9e1e8;color:#8a1738}.decision-panel{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:14px;align-items:center;background:#f8f9fc;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:15px;margin:18px 0}.decision-panel h3{margin:0 0 4px}.decision-panel p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.decision-panel .decision-actions{grid-column:1/-1}.decision-hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#172033,#3c4964);color:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:24px;margin:5px 0 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:22px}.decision-hero h2{font-size:28px;margin:3px 0 8px}.decision-hero p{max-width:850px;margin:0;color:#dce3f2}.export-btn{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.42);border-radius:12px;background:#fff;color:#172033;padding:11px 15px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}.clear-decision{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:underline;font-size:12px;padding:5px}.decision-note{background:#eef3fb;border:1px solid #d8e1f0;border-radius:15px;padding:13px 15px;color:#41516c;margin:14px 0 18px}
.hidden{display:none!important}
@media(max-width:950px){.kpis,.gr-kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.toolbar,.gr-toolbar{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.focus{grid-template-columns:1fr}.logo-ribbon{grid-template-columns:repeat(9,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:620px){.shell{padding:0 14px 40px}.hero{padding:24px 15px 42px}.hero-mark{width:78px;height:78px;border-radius:20px}.hero-mark img{width:60px;height:60px}.logo-ribbon{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr)}.kpis,.gr-kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;margin-top:-20px}.gr-kpis{margin-top:0}.kpi{padding:13px}.kpi b{font-size:23px}.toolbar,.gr-toolbar{grid-template-columns:1fr;position:static}.university-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.uni{min-height:170px}.bar{grid-template-columns:90px 1fr 40px}.record{grid-template-columns:42px 1fr}.record>a{grid-column:2}.section-head{align-items:start;flex-direction:column}.gr-hero,.decision-hero{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.gr-stamp{text-align:left}.decision-panel{grid-template-columns:1fr}.decision-actions{min-width:210px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="hero">
  <div class="hero-org">Rutgers University Libraries</div>
  <div class="hero-top">
    <div><h1>Microfilm across the Big Ten Academic Alliance</h1><p>Explore 382 Rutgers inventory titles against catalog signals from 17 peer universities. Candidate matches are leads for record-level format and coverage verification.</p></div>
    <div class="hero-mark"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Rutgers University logo"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="logo-ribbon" id="logoRibbon" aria-label="BTAA member university logos"></div>
</header>
<main class="shell">
  <section class="kpis">
    <div class="kpi"><b>18</b><span>BTAA member universities</span></div>
    <div class="kpi"><b>6,494</b><span>catalog comparisons attempted</span></div>
    <div class="kpi"><b id="candidateKpi">841</b><span>possible microform signals</span></div>
    <div class="kpi"><b id="titleKpi">279</b><span>Rutgers titles with candidates</span></div>
  </section>
  <nav class="tabs" aria-label="Dashboard views">
    <button class="tab active" data-view="network">University network</button>
    <button class="tab" data-view="titles">Title explorer</button>
    <button class="tab" data-view="rutgers">Rutgers-only review</button>
    <button class="tab" data-view="decisions">Team decisions</button>
    <button class="tab" data-view="gold">Gold Rush comparison</button>
    <button class="tab" data-view="glossary">Glossary &amp; definitions</button>
  </nav>
  <section class="toolbar" id="catalogToolbar">
    <input class="control" id="search" type="search" placeholder="Search inventory titles, dates, or universities">
    <select class="control" id="universityFilter"><option value="">All universities</option></select>
    <select class="control" id="statusFilter"><option value="">All catalog statuses</option><option value="rutgers_only">Rutgers-only candidates</option><option value="possible">Possible microform signal</option><option value="not_found">No candidate detected</option><option value="not_checked">Not checked</option></select>
    <button class="reset" id="reset">Reset</button>
  </section>
  <section id="networkView">
    <div class="section-head"><div><h2>University network</h2><p>Select a logo card to focus the analysis and title list.</p></div><p id="networkNote"></p></div>
    <div class="university-grid" id="universityGrid"></div>
    <div class="focus">
      <article class="panel" id="focusPanel"></article>
      <article class="panel"><div class="section-head"><div><h2>Highest-overlap titles</h2><p>Ranked by number of catalog candidate signals.</p></div></div><div class="rank-list" id="rankList"></div></article>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section id="titlesView">
    <div class="section-head"><div><h2>Title explorer</h2><p>Click a title for its Rutgers coverage and university evidence.</p></div><p id="resultCount"></p></div>
    <div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Rutgers inventory title</th><th>Local coverage</th><th>Candidate universities</th><th>Status</th><th>Evidence</th><th>Catalogue action</th></tr></thead><tbody id="titleRows"></tbody></table></div>
  </section>
  <section id="rutgersView" class="hidden">
    <div class="rutgers-only-hero">
      <div><div class="eyebrow">Collection review category</div><h2>Rutgers-only candidates</h2><p>These Rutgers microfilm titles produced no external candidate signal across the 16 peer catalogs successfully reviewed. They are prioritized for uniqueness review, but they are not confirmed exclusive because one BTAA catalog remained unavailable and public catalog evidence is not exhaustive.</p></div>
      <div class="review-meter"><b id="rutgersOnlyCount">—</b><span>titles needing final verification</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="gr-kpis">
      <div class="kpi"><b id="rutgersOnlyTitles">—</b><span>no external candidate signal</span></div>
      <div class="kpi"><b>16 of 17</b><span>peer catalogs reviewed per title</span></div>
      <div class="kpi"><b>1</b><span>peer catalog unavailable</span></div>
      <div class="kpi"><b>0</b><span>confirmed exclusive titles</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="gr-note"><b>Interpretation:</b> “Rutgers-only candidate” means no possible signal was detected in the checked BTAA catalog evidence. It does not mean the title is unavailable elsewhere. Confirmed Rutgers-only status requires the remaining catalog review plus verification of bibliographic identity, physical microform format, and date/volume coverage.</div>
    <div class="section-head"><div><h2>Records prioritized for uniqueness review</h2><p>Select a title to inspect all university-level catalog results.</p></div><p id="rutgersOnlyResultCount"></p></div>
    <div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Rutgers inventory title</th><th>Local coverage</th><th>Inventory</th><th>Peer review</th><th>Category</th><th>Catalogue action</th></tr></thead><tbody id="rutgersOnlyRows"></tbody></table></div>
  </section>
  <section id="decisionsView" class="hidden">
    <div class="decision-hero">
      <div><div class="eyebrow">Collection workflow</div><h2>Team catalogue decisions</h2><p>Record whether each Rutgers microfilm item is being kept in or removed from the catalogue. These actions update the dashboard’s decision log; they do not delete inventory or comparison evidence.</p></div>
      <button class="export-btn" id="exportDecisions" type="button">Export decisions as CSV</button>
    </div>
    <div class="gr-kpis">
      <div class="kpi"><b id="decisionKept">0</b><span>items kept in catalogue</span></div>
      <div class="kpi"><b id="decisionRemoved">0</b><span>items removed from catalogue</span></div>
      <div class="kpi"><b id="decisionPending">382</b><span>items awaiting a decision</span></div>
      <div class="kpi"><b id="decisionTotal">0</b><span>decisions recorded</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="decision-note"><b>Sharing note:</b> decisions are saved in this browser on this device. Use the CSV export to circulate or archive the current log; publishing the static webpage does not automatically synchronize decisions between team members.</div>
    <div class="section-head"><div><h2>Recorded decisions</h2><p>Update a decision with either action button. Use “Clear decision” to return an item to pending.</p></div><p id="decisionResultCount"></p></div>
    <div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Rutgers inventory title</th><th>Decision</th><th>Updated</th><th>Inventory</th><th>Catalogue action</th></tr></thead><tbody id="decisionRows"></tbody></table></div>
  </section>
  <section id="goldView" class="hidden">
    <div class="gr-hero">
      <div><div class="eyebrow">New analysis · Gold Rush comparison export</div><h2>Dana microfilm overlap</h2><p>Direct catalog-record comparison using the workbook’s “Microfilm - BTAA + Dana” sheet. Repeated rows are collapsed into unique Dana title × university relationships.</p></div>
      <div class="gr-stamp"><b id="grDuplicateRate">—</b><span>Dana titles with external holdings</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="gr-kpis">
      <div class="kpi"><b id="grDanaTitles">—</b><span>unique Dana catalog titles</span></div>
      <div class="kpi"><b id="grDuplicateTitles">—</b><span>titles duplicated externally</span></div>
      <div class="kpi"><b id="grOnlyTitles">—</b><span>Dana-only in this export</span></div>
      <div class="kpi"><b id="grPairs">—</b><span>unique title × university pairs</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="gr-toolbar">
      <input class="control" id="grSearch" type="search" placeholder="Search Gold Rush titles, publishers, identifiers">
      <select class="control" id="grUniversity"><option value="">All universities</option></select>
      <select class="control" id="grOverlap"><option value="">All overlap levels</option><option value="only">Dana-only in export</option><option value="1">1 university</option><option value="2-5">2–5 universities</option><option value="6-10">6–10 universities</option><option value="11">11+ universities</option></select>
      <button class="reset" id="grReset">Reset</button>
    </div>
    <div class="section-head"><div><h2>Constituent overlap</h2><p>Unique Dana titles represented at each external institution in the Gold Rush export.</p></div><p id="grInstitutionNote"></p></div>
    <div class="gr-grid" id="grUniversityGrid"></div>
    <div class="gr-note"><b>How to read this tab:</b> “Duplicate” means a bibliographic holding relationship in this Gold Rush export. It is stronger than the earlier catalog-search candidates, but final retention decisions should still verify physical microfilm format and date/volume coverage. The three “Dana-only” titles mean that no corresponding external record was found in this particular Gold Rush export; they are not confirmed as exclusive worldwide. UCLA was absent from the supplied sheet, while the University of Chicago was included and is shown as reported by the workbook.</div>
    <div class="section-head"><div><h2>Title-level comparison</h2><p>Choose a title to see all matched institutions and match methods.</p></div><p id="grResultCount"></p></div>
    <div class="table-wrap gr-table"><table><thead><tr><th>Dana catalog title</th><th>Publication</th><th>Identifiers</th><th>External universities</th><th>Match basis</th></tr></thead><tbody id="grTitleRows"></tbody></table></div>
  </section>
  <section id="glossaryView" class="hidden">
    <div class="glossary-intro">
      <div class="eyebrow">Terminology guide</div>
      <h2>How to read the dashboard</h2>
      <p>These definitions explain the matching language, catalog-review statuses, identifiers, and collection-scope statements used throughout the dashboard. They are interpretation aids—not substitutes for reviewing the underlying catalog records.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="glossary-group">
      <h3>Matching and duplicate language</h3>
      <div class="glossary-grid">
        <article class="term-card"><h4>Normalized title</h4><p>A standardized title used for comparison after differences such as capitalization, punctuation, spacing, and selected leading words are reduced. Records with differently formatted titles may therefore compare as the same title.</p><span class="term-caution">A normalized-title match alone does not confirm an exact duplicate.</span></article>
        <article class="term-card"><h4>Possible / possible microform signal</h4><p>A catalog search produced title- or institution-level evidence that may represent the Rutgers item, but publication identity, physical format, edition, or coverage is not sufficiently verified.</p><span class="term-caution">“Possible” is an evidence status, not a probability score.</span></article>
        <article class="term-card"><h4>Candidate match / candidate signal</h4><p>A lead selected for additional record-level review. In this dashboard it generally refers to a possible microform signal found through a university catalog search.</p></article>
        <article class="term-card"><h4>Confirmed duplicate</h4><p>A compatible bibliographic identity and microform format have been verified at another institution, with sufficiently compatible date, volume, or issue coverage to represent genuine duplication.</p></article>
        <article class="term-card"><h4>Gold Rush duplicate</h4><p>A Dana title linked to at least one external institutional record in the supplied Gold Rush export, using normalized title or identifiers. This is stronger than a general catalog-search candidate but still requires format and coverage review for retention decisions.</p></article>
        <article class="term-card"><h4>Rutgers-only candidate</h4><p>A Rutgers title with no external candidate signal in the peer catalogs successfully checked during this analysis.</p><span class="term-caution">It is a review priority, not a confirmed exclusivity claim.</span></article>
        <article class="term-card"><h4>Match basis</h4><p>The field used to connect records, such as normalized title, ISSN, or primary OCLC number. More than one basis may support the same relationship.</p></article>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="glossary-group">
      <h3>Catalog-review statuses</h3>
      <div class="glossary-grid">
        <article class="term-card"><h4>No candidate detected</h4><p>The search was attempted but did not produce a defensible candidate record during this review.</p><span class="term-caution">This is not proof that the institution does not own the title.</span></article>
        <article class="term-card"><h4>Not found</h4><p>The relevant record and visible holdings were reviewed, and the institution was not listed in the evidence available at that time.</p><span class="term-caution">Missing public holdings are not proof of absolute absence.</span></article>
        <article class="term-card"><h4>Not checked</h4><p>No defensible catalog review was completed. This may result from an unavailable catalog, access restriction, technical failure, or unfinished review.</p></article>
        <article class="term-card"><h4>Catalog unavailable</h4><p>The library catalog endpoint could not be reviewed during the analysis. Its titles remain unchecked and must not be interpreted as no-match results.</p></article>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="glossary-group">
      <h3>Scope and exclusivity language</h3>
      <div class="glossary-grid">
        <article class="term-card"><h4>Dana-only in this export</h4><p>No corresponding external record was found for the Dana title in the particular Gold Rush export supplied for this analysis.</p><span class="term-caution">It does not establish worldwide or even BTAA-wide exclusivity.</span></article>
        <article class="term-card"><h4>Rutgers only in checked BTAA evidence</h4><p>Rutgers is confirmed and every other reviewed BTAA institution has a completed no-match result, with no possible or unchecked rows remaining.</p><span class="term-caution">The statement applies only to the checked BTAA evidence—not all libraries worldwide.</span></article>
        <article class="term-card"><h4>External holding</h4><p>A bibliographic holding relationship reported for a non-Rutgers institution in the source data. It may not describe the institution’s exact physical format or local coverage.</p></article>
        <article class="term-card"><h4>Coverage overlap</h4><p>The extent to which another institution’s dates, volumes, or issues coincide with the Rutgers microfilm holdings. Matching titles without overlapping coverage may not be operational duplicates.</p></article>
        <article class="term-card"><h4>Physical microform format</h4><p>The carrier type—such as microfilm, microfiche, or another reproduction format. A print or electronic holding is not automatically a duplicate of a microfilm holding.</p></article>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="glossary-group">
      <h3>Counts, records, and identifiers</h3>
      <div class="glossary-grid">
        <article class="term-card"><h4>Unique title × university pair</h4><p>One distinct relationship between a normalized Dana title and one external university. Repeated source rows for the same title and university are counted once.</p></article>
        <article class="term-card"><h4>Catalog control / bibliographic record</h4><p>A catalog record describing a publication. One title may have several controls because of different editions, formats, publishers, or cataloging histories.</p></article>
        <article class="term-card"><h4>OCLC number</h4><p>A numeric identifier assigned to a WorldCat bibliographic record. Matching OCLC numbers are strong identity evidence, but holdings format and coverage should still be verified.</p></article>
        <article class="term-card"><h4>ISSN</h4><p>The International Standard Serial Number used to identify a serial publication. An ISSN can link related records but may not distinguish every edition or physical format.</p></article>
        <article class="term-card"><h4>Local coverage</h4><p>The dates, volumes, issues, or ranges recorded for the Rutgers inventory item. Coverage data are essential for determining whether another holding truly duplicates the usable content.</p></article>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="glossary-rule"><b>Interpretation rule:</b> never convert an unchecked catalog into a no-match result, and never treat a missing public holding or a Dana-only result as proof of global uniqueness.</div>
  </section>
  <p class="footnote">A catalog signal is not a confirmed duplicate. Confirmation requires matching publication identity, physical microform format, owning library, and overlapping date/volume coverage. Iowa’s 382 catalog requests remained unavailable.</p>
</main>
